title: SanaCkoala
description:
[b]SanaCkoala[/b] adds two new playable characters to Slay the Spire 2, the Koala and the Panda. Both work in singleplayer, and they are built to play well together in co-op.

[h2]The Koala[/h2]
70 HP. Starter relic: [b]Eucalyptus Leaf[/b] (start each combat with 3 Drowsy).
[list]
[*][b]Drowsy[/b]: at the end of your turn, gain Block equal to your Drowsy.
[*][b]Waking up[/b]: some cards remove all of your Drowsy at once for a big effect.
[*]Three ways to play: keep stacking Drowsy and never wake up; stack it, then wake up for burst damage or Energy; or Retain cards that grow stronger the longer you hold them.
[/list]

[h2]The Panda[/h2]
80 HP. Starter relic: [b]Bamboo Basket[/b] (start each combat with 3 Bamboo).
[list]
[*][b]Bamboo[/b] is a resource you gather with cards and powers.
[*][b]Munch N[/b]: if you have at least N Bamboo, the card spends it and triggers a bonus effect.
[*]Three ways to play: hoard Bamboo and munch it, turn Block into damage, or build Strength.
[/list]

The Koala has 36 cards and the Panda has 35, counting their own Strike and Defend. Each character also has four relics and two potions on top of the starter relic.

[h2]Co-op content[/h2]
In multiplayer runs, both characters start with [b]Hold Hands[/b], and five more colorless cards can appear: [b]Share a Bite[/b], [b]Quarrel[/b], [b]Make Up[/b], [b]Assist[/b] and [b]Promise[/b]. Each character also has co-op cards of their own ([b]Nap Together[/b], [b]Share Bamboo[/b], [b]Shelter[/b]), and two shared relics can drop. These only show up when there is more than one player.

[h2]Installation[/h2]
[list]
[*]Requires [b]BaseLib[/b]. Steam asks you to subscribe to it as well.
[*]Subscribe and start the game. The first time, the game asks whether to load mods; allow it.
[*]For multiplayer, every player needs this mod on the same version.
[*]Do not also keep a manual copy in the game's [i]mods[/i] folder.
[*]Modded play uses a separate set of save files. Your unmodded saves are not touched. On a fresh modded save, the mod still starts act 1 with Neow.
[/list]

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
Tested on game version v0.107.1 only. Other versions may not load.

Fan-made mod, not affiliated with or endorsed by Mega Crit. Card and relic art made with AI image generation.
changeNote: v0.2.0: 27 new cards, 8 new relics and 4 potions, so each character now has three playstyles. Reworked Rude Awakening (now Wide Awake), Dark Circles, Pincer (now Assist), Share a Bite, Shelter and several other cards, and rebalanced numbers. Fixed Neow missing from act 1 on fresh modded saves, the first chest offering two identical relics in co-op, and relics showing the wrong mod name. Every player needs to update before playing together.
